ada: Heads-up: Accessibility review for Bulk Actions modal. Keyboard users are getting trapped when modal opens while a dropdown inside is focused. Modal has focus trap but dropdown's portal focuses another tabbable element outside modal. Repro: Console > Models > select 3 > Bulk Actions > open > press Tab repeatedly -> focus escapes to header search.
max-pm: Repro'd. It looks like the action menu uses a portal to body and has tabindex=0 on container.
jamal: Can confirm. Dropdown lib renders menu in body for overflow; focusable items are inside that portal so our modal trap doesn't catch them. Easy fix: on modal open, add the portal node to the modal's inert/focus-trap scope or move portal to inside modal DOM.
access-bot: scan: HIGH: focus can escape modal causing keyboard users to lose context. MEDIUM: portal lacks aria-modal annotation and menu items missing aria-activedescendant keyboard handling. LOW: close-button focus ring in high-contrast mode fails 3:1 around the yellow bg.
ada (typo)?: nice catch.
ada??: (ignore)
ada should be ada.
ada??: oops :)

ada to keep thread clean
ada: ignore, small keyboard typo in my testing notes.
max-pm: Proposal: when Bulk Actions modal opens, register any portal roots used by child components with the modal's focus trap. For our focus-trap util we can accept extra container nodes: focusTrap.addScope([modalRoot, dropdownPortalRoot]). Also update dropdown to expose an optional parent prop to mount inside modal if provided.
jamal: Alternate: set aria-hidden="true" on siblings outside modal and ensure portal inherits inert state. But ARIA-hidden can break other assistive tech; prefer explicit focus-trap scope.
access-bot: recommendation: add aria-modal="true" to the modal container, ensure focus is programmatically moved to the modal dialog or first focusable element, and when modal closes restore previous focus. Also add unit/E2E for keyboard tab sequence to detect regressions.
max-pm: UX question: when portal is moved into modal, will z-index/positioning still work for long menus? We might need to preserve absolute positioning by computing offsets.
jamal: We can keep portal positioning by using CSS transform offsets or using popper's strategy to attach to relative container. Implementation detail but feasible.
ada: Also need to ensure screen readers announce context when focus moves into portal menu. Menu should have role=menu and an accessible label, plus aria-expanded on the trigger.
max-pm: QA: @qa-bot can you add regression tests: 1) open modal, tab through, ensure no focus escape; 2) open dropdown inside modal, tab through menu items, close menu, focus returns to trigger; 3) test in VoiceOver and NVDA that modal announces and menu reads as menu.
qa-bot: Will add tests to the release branch. Adding a test matrix entry for mac+VO and windows+NVDA. Also will assert aria-modal presence and focus restore.
ada: I'll make a small PR: focus-trap scope support + dropdown optional mountNode prop + docs. I'll include screenshots and the failing livelytest log.
max-pm: Please keep change small and behind feature-flag for safety. After canary, we'll flip for all.
jamal: Once PR lands, I'll run accessibility smoke locally and run axe to confirm no focusable nodes outside modal.
access-bot: Extra nit: focus-ring color for close button on yellow bg should be #073642 to meet contrast; suggest using focus token --focus-on-yellow: 2px solid #073642.
ada: Noted; will apply token in PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
